text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the Asahi Hai<n>Futurity Stakes
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The stands are packed—though I<n>would expect no
less of a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer. I imagine the nerves<n>must be starting
to sink in.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Then once again, I'll let you take<n>on the
nervous feeling for the both of<n>us. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai F.S. is not the only<n>challenge I face
today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The attendees undoubtedly have only<n>Maruzensky
on the mind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why I have to do my<n>best.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not as "the next Maruzensky" or<n>"Maruzensky's
successor," but as a<n>runner with the ability to reach
the top.
